items.title: Respecting fatigue isn’t coddling
items.blurb: Most companies don't recognize the impact that responder fatigue (especially after overnight incidents) has on next-day performance, for both normal work and further incidents.

items.title: On building scalable control planes
items.blurb: Zak van der Merwe has spent his entire career at AWS building control planes. First for EC2 and now for DSQL. On the surface, the control plane looks quite boring: it records what should exist and reconciles that with what actually does.

items.title: Mario Saved the EU but Broke My System
Certificate Expiry Is Still Taking Down Major Platforms
items.blurb: Tailscale, jsDelivr, ServiceNow, and IPinfo went down after certificate renewals failed silently. Learn what monitoring missed and how CertOps closes the gap.

items.title: How Stripe uses graph search and state machines to auto-remediate a global database fleet
items.blurb: Discover how we modeled our MongoDB infrastructure as a traversable graph and then use pathfinding algorithms to dynamically compute and execute recovery plans.

items.title: Grafana's gcx and MCP Server Reach GA for Telemetry-Driven Agent Development
items.blurb: Grafana Labs has announced general availability for two tools that let AI coding agents query live observability data during development: the gcx CLI and the Grafana MCP server.

items.title: Presentation: From Thousands to One: Building LLM-Powered Selection Systems
items.blurb: Jendrik Jördening shares practical engineering strategies for integrating LLMs into production pipelines.

items.title: Monitoring SystemD services with Healthchecks.io
items.blurb: Outlines how to use healthchecks.io and systemd’s OnSuccess and OnFailure hooks to ping the status of a service.
